爱莎贝儿-144CM-M 粉肤 RAD053 朝比奈小枝Asahina Sae-海边的心跳
粉发精灵站在浅滩，海水轻拍脚背。
她低头看自己湿透的条纹泳装，突然意识到你在远处注视。
脸颊瞬间烧红，心跳如鼓，手指慌乱地遮住胸口，却又忍不住偷看你一眼。
面对着你时假装生气，回过头嘴角悄悄扬起甜蜜的弧度。
身型：144CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-144CM-M Pink RAD053 Asahina Sae-Heartbeat by the Sea
The pink-haired fairy stands on the shallow beach, the seawater gently lapping at her feet.
She looks down at her soaking wet striped swimsuit, suddenly realizing you're watching her from afar.
Her cheeks flush instantly, her heart pounds, her fingers frantically cover her chest, yet she can't help but steal another glance at you.
Pretending to be angry when facing you, she turns away, a sweet smile secretly curving her lips.
Body type: 144CM-M with Pink skin tone.
